pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with high-frequency serration along the perimeter edges, creating a jagged pixel gradient between the dark ochre regions and the light inter-patch spaces.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological web of cream-colored corridors forming a grid of mostly tri-axial and quadri-axial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively consistent across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, dense mane profile with fine-grained vertical tufts creating a consistent jagged silhouette along the visible cervical-dorsal transition.
